semantics: External distribution and supplementary representations of canonical DIO/ODI works. Existing relation types observed on Zenodo are evidence of prior metadata choices, not automatically authoritative semantic classifications.
relation_rule: Treat existing Zenodo Related Works relation types as observed metadata until independently verified. IsIdenticalTo requires the exact same research output in two locations. IsSupplementedBy requires the related resource to be a genuine supplement, not merely another distribution copy. Where exact equivalence is not established, keep the relation under semantic review.
